requiredPreviousStage: Current committed dictionaryhub repository at the start of Chunk 0
rollbackInstructions: Open the installer-created timestamped backup and read installation-record.json.
Restore every replaced file from its repository-relative path in the backup.
Remove only files recorded in addedFiles when a complete rollback is required.
Run the verification appropriate to the restored repository.
knownLimitations: Static verification does not establish browser behavior.
The baseline verifiers do not call a live API or PostgreSQL.
The prompt roadmap classification differs from the later-scope files already present in the inspected repository.
Basic secret-pattern scanning is not a substitute for a dedicated credential audit.
explicitExclusions: New pagination or error response contracts
Production hosting, billing, white labeling, dashboards, or commercial automation
